key_fields.name: CUSTOMER-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 500-byte customer master record (header comment RECLN 500; field sizes add up to 500).

key_fields.name: CUST-ID
key_fields.meaning: 9-digit customer identifier, key of the customer file.

key_fields.name: CUST-FIRST-NAME
key_fields.meaning: Customer first name; with middle and last name forms the statement name line in CBSTM03A.

key_fields.name: CUST-ADDR-LINE-1
key_fields.meaning: First of three 50-byte address lines, followed by state, country and ZIP codes.

key_fields.name: CUST-DOB-YYYYMMDD
key_fields.meaning: Date of birth, 10 bytes (name differs from CVCUS01Y's CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD).

key_fields.name: CUST-FICO-CREDIT-SCORE
key_fields.meaning: 3-digit FICO credit score, printed on statements.

observations.text: Lines 6-22 begin with tab characters instead of spaces, so the source is not aligned to standard fixed-format columns; compilers or tools that do not expand tabs may misread it.
Near-duplicate of CVCUS01Y: same 500-byte layout, but the date-of-birth field is named CUST-DOB-YYYYMMDD here and CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD in CVCUS01Y.

purpose: CUSTREC defines CUSTOMER-RECORD, the 500-byte customer entity: id, names, three address lines, state/country/ZIP, two phone numbers, SSN, government id, date of birth, EFT account id, primary card holder indicator and FICO score. It is a variant of CVCUS01Y used only by the statement program CBSTM03A, which receives the customer record from CBSTM03B and prints name, address and FICO score on statements.
